呪術廻戦 [Jujutsu Kaisen] #8

Jujutsu Kaisen, Vol. 8

Gege Akutami

4.59
24,162 ratings1,792 reviews
Rate this book
In a world where cursed spirits feed on unsuspecting humans, fragments of the legendary and feared demon Ryomen Sukuna were lost and scattered about. Should any demon consume Sukuna’s body parts, the power they gain could destroy the world as we know it. Fortunately, there exists a mysterious school of Jujutsu Sorcerers who exist to protect the precarious existence of the living from the supernatural!

Yuji Itadori and his classmates are fighting two of the three reincarnated Cursed Womb: Death Paintings brothers. Meanwhile, Megumi Fushiguro loses consciousness after finally defeating a special grade curse that possessed a Sukuna finger! Whoever wins the fight between Itadori and the brothers will be the one to secure the prized finger!

About the author

Gege Akutami

136 books4,232 followers
Gege Akutami 芥見下々 is a Japanese manga author, known for their work Jujutsu Kaisen.

The author does not show their face in public, and their gender is not disclosed.
They previously worked as assistant to mangaka Yasuhiro Kanō.

July 26, 2021
“Society should protect the weak and keep the strong in check. You see Satoru, Jujutsu exists to protect non-jujutsu users.”


Everything about this volume was so delightful I couldn't help but squeal a lot.

Seriously, I don't know what I was expecting when I started to read it, but it wasn't quite expecting the very different perspective that we got to explore more of the characters, the story, and the world in general.

It was clever and funny, filled with interesting ideas and the gut-wrenching knowledge that something terrible looms just around the corner like a nightmare it had me hooked and raving in instants.

“Those who are focused on a single way to win are easy to manipulate when presented with the opportunity.”


The characters, though familiar, were all really refreshing and interesting to get to know better... or, rather, to get to understand better.

I'll admit, that the change in perspective disoriented me a little at first but, well, I can hardly argue with the way it expands and details the events that are currently happening. After all, our present is hardly ever standing alone in an isolated, frozen moment.

Let's not forget that it was also rather amusing.

Seeing the personal beliefs of certain characters also shed some light on their actions, as it's often the case, and made it all the more fascinating.

“Anyway, it should be okay. We’re the strongest.”

____________

This was a lot more fun than I was expecting... and also way much tenser than I had thought.

I need to grab the next volume ASAP.

RTC.
____________

I am beyond excited to finally be reading this volume as, finally, here starts what I don't know about the story and I AM ALL HERE FOR IT.

I suspect, rather strongly, that things are going to go very wrong soon, way sooner than later, and I'm not sure I'm here for it. I need all the characters to be happy, and Yuuji to remain the sunshine child he is. Anything else is unacceptable.

Volume eight is a pretty solid volume. It wraps up the death painting arc and begins Gojo’s past arc. The major flaw to this volume is it introduces two really interesting characters… but the series never gives them the full-fledged attention they deserve. There is so much mystery surrounding them that is never resolved. Yuko’s brief chapter shows Yuji’s sweet personality really well, but she basically gets ignored for the rest of the series. Yu is a character who seems sweet, but again, he gets completely ignored and you never get his ending explained. There was a lot of missed potential with these two characters.

Jujutsu Kaisen vol. 8 is where season 1 of the anime ends and where season 2 will start, I'm so excited to read it. Now I'm half way through and it really doesn't disappoint!

At the beginning, we got to see Yuji and Co. fighting two of the Cursed Infants brothers and the fight scene is very impressive!

Then in the next part, we go back in time to see the younger Satoru, Geto and Shoko in their high school year and they are just sooooo cute!! I even like Riko Amanai as well!!! But Megumi's dad is scary!!! I also like the younger version of Utahemi and Mei Mei doing a mission together (before they got interrupted. LOL)

The interaction among Satoru, Geto and Riko is also so cute damn it! So it makes what happens next to be even sadder.

PS: the author really doesn't mind killing off their characters it is damn scary!!!!

PSS: I saw this fanart online and I do believe it's what the Fushiguro Family's homelife would have looked like if things were different. XD
